findings: Canonical frontend changes to subscribed only after the existing authenticated register API confirms success, except reuse of a previously bound in-memory registration.
API validates current actor and commits the subscription before returning success.
Independent lookup for exact owned testers across all six subscription schemas found no active rows. Live worker retains only the earlier PC producer/delivery history.
Human-reported subscribed state is preserved but its runtime correlation is unresolved. These facts do not establish a specific application bug or justify a speculative code change.
